- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# pr-1618: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)

## Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

---

### Thread 7 — `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog"**

```dart
final sourceLabel = switch (existingSource) {
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
  _ => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
};
```

Today the value domain is closed (`catalog`/`unpacked` records, the never-persisted `agent` sentinel), so this is latent only — but if a future origin ever lands in `.installed.json` (e.g. a CLI load, the ticket's second tier), the replace dialog would claim it came from the catalog. Surfacing the raw value (or a neutral "unknown source" arb string) keeps the dialog honest without a matching case per origin.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# pr-1618: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)

## Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

Hmm — with reject, that exact pin translates to: the padded id NEVER installs, so the padded mismatch can't lose the badge or break Remove. But I can also pin the positive invariants end-to-end: install a trimmed-id manifest → `listApps` shows `installSource == 'unpacked'` (exists in restart test) → `removeWidget` deletes the folder (may exist elsewhere? let me grep removeWidget tests in test/apps). Let me add to the loader test: after install, `store.removeWidget('fa-agents', force: true)` → folder gone. That's a genuine regression pin for the class (manifest-id == folder-name invariant), cheap to add.

Wait — but what does `removeWidget` do exactly? Let me check apps_store.removeWidget signature and behavior. It's on AppsStore. And the UI Remove call sites use `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)`.

3. `test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — rewrite "AC4: a padded-id pick still warns over the trimmed-id install" → the padded pick now shows the named-issues dialog (AC2) instead of the confirm: expect `UnpackedLoadIssuesDialog`, the id_invalid text, no warning icon, and nothing written (existing install untouched).

**GREEN**: add the rule in `_checkSchema`:

```dart
final rawId = stamped['id'];
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
  if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
    errors.add(
      WidgetPayloadError(
        'id_invalid',
        "manifest id '$rawId' must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
            'write "${rawId.trim()}" in manifest.json',
      ),
    );
  }
  _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
}
```

Careful about the `_checkId` dedupe interacting with the whitespace error: `_checkId(trimmed, errors)` checks `errors.any((error) => error.code == 'id_invalid' && error.message.contains("'$trimmed'"))`. My whitespace message contains `"' fa-agents '"` and `'"fa-agents"'` (double-quoted in suggestion). Does it contain `"'fa-agents'"` (quote + trimmed + quote)? `"' fa-agents '"` — substring `"'fa-agents'"` would need quote immediately followed by trimmed followed by quote. ## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# pr-1618: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)

## Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).

  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`

- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

}
```

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

- **PR #**: 1618

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

---

### Thread 7 — `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog"**

```dart
final sourceLabel = switch (existingSource) {
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
  _ => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
};
```

Today the value domain is closed (`catalog`/`unpacked` records, the never-persisted `agent` sentinel), so this is latent only — but if a future origin ever lands in `.installed.json` (e.g. a CLI load, the ticket's second tier), the replace dialog would claim it came from the catalog. Surfacing the raw value (or a neutral "unknown source" arb string) keeps the dialog honest without a matching case per origin.

  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).

  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).

  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1618._

> ℹ️ **5 resolved thread(s) excluded; 4 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 6 — `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

---

### Thread 7 — `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog"**

```dart
final sourceLabel = switch (existingSource) {
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
  UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
  _ => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
};
```

Today the value domain is closed (`catalog`/`unpacked` records, the never-persisted `agent` sentinel), so this is latent only — but if a future origin ever lands in `.installed.json` (e.g. a CLI load, the ticket's second tier), the replace dialog would claim it came from the catalog. Surfacing the raw value (or a neutral "unknown source" arb string) keeps the dialog honest without a matching case per origin.

---

### Thread 8

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1618
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1618
- **Title**: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1616` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 25
- **Additions**: +2743
- **Deletions**: -23
- **Created**: 2026-10-14T22:10:16Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-15T01:22:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>
