# pr-1618: gh-1616 [GOAL] Unpacked widgets: load a local apps/ id / folder into the extension (Chrome 'Load unpacked' parity)

## Description

Closes #1616
### What changed
Chrome-parity "Load unpacked": a locally picked `apps/<id>/` folder (manifest + assets) is validated, copied into the env's `apps/` store via `AppsStore.installSource`, and appears on the launcher grid with an "unpacked" provenance badge — on web via `showDirectoryPicker`, hidden on hosts without a folder picker.

### Key decisions
- New `UnpackedWidgetLoader` + `UnpackedLoadFlow` (`lib/apps/`) reuse `WidgetPayloadValidator` from publish — one rule set for catalog, publish and local loads
- `installSource` field on `JsAppInfo` (persisted) distinguishes `catalog` / `unpacked` instead of a separate registry
- Conditional-import `FolderPicker` abstraction: web reads `FileSystemDirectoryHandle` entries recursively; stub returns null → entry hidden, not broken
- Overwrite confirmed with a question modal; rejections carry actionable l10n copy (missing manifest, id mismatch, orphan files, unsupported platform) — en/ru added
- Corner badge composes with the existing seed-error badge; entry points: launcher tab row (icon chip) and AppsPanel text button

### How to verify
```bash
cd flutter_app && flutter test test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart \
  test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart \
  test/golden/unpacked_load_golden_test.dart
```
Manual (web build): load a folder without `manifest.json` → snack names the missing path; valid folder → confirm → tile on grid with folder badge.

<details><summary>Architecture</summary>

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  BTN[Load unpacked buttons] --> FLOW[UnpackedLoadFlow]
  FLOW --> PICK[FolderPicker web/stub]
  FLOW --> VAL[WidgetPayloadValidator]
  VAL -->|valid| CP[UnpackedWidgetLoader copy]
  CP --> STORE[AppsStore.installSource=unpacked]
  STORE --> GRID[Launcher grid + folder badge]
  VAL -->|invalid| SNACK[l10n error snack]
```

</details>

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-15):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the trim fix normalizes the folder/record but the stored manifest keeps the padded id — provenance badge is lost and Remove silently no-ops**

`UnpackedInspection.id` now trims (correct — verified: a `" fa-agents "` manifest lands in `apps/fa-agents/` with a trimmed `.installed.json` key), but the manifest **bytes** are stored unchanged, so `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` still parses the model `id` as `" fa-agents "` (padded) while every record is keyed by the trimmed form:

- **Badge/chip lost (I3)**: `listApps` attaches provenance via `sources[app.id]` — the padded model id misses the trimmed record key → `installSource` is `null` → no unpacked corner badge, no catalog-sheet chip.
- **Remove silently no-ops**: every Remove call site uses `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` — the padded id targets `apps/ fa-agents /` (doesn't exist), so no file is deleted, `meta.remove` misses the trimmed key (zombie record), and `removeWidget` still returns `true` → the UI reports success and the tile reappears on the next reload.

This is the same "manifest id ≠ folder name" hazard agent-created apps already have on main — the padded id is just a new way to enter it, and this PR's own validator lets it through. The one-rule fix (AC2 spirit — named errors, never silent weirdness) is in the validator:

```dart
if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(const WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id must not have leading/trailing whitespace — "
        "use the trimmed form in manifest.json",
  ));
}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty && rawId.trim() != rawId) {

}
```

(or rewrite the manifest bytes with the trimmed id at install — rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest). A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it.

  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`

  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →

  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with

  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in

  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

Merge concluded. Now let me look at the current code for the two threads:

**Thread 1 (IMPORTANT, `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6slNaR`)**: The stored manifest keeps the padded id. The fix suggested: reject in `WidgetPayloadValidator` when `rawId.trim() != rawId` with named `id_invalid` error, OR rewrite manifest bytes with trimmed id at install. Reviewer prefers rejecting ("rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest"). Tests needed: padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder.

Wait — if we reject padded ids, then a padded-id manifest never installs, so the "badge renders + Remove deletes folder" test would be about... hmm. The reviewer said "A padded-id test asserting the badge renders (`installSource == 'unpacked'`) and Remove actually deletes the folder would pin it." If we reject, then the test would assert that a padded-id manifest is REJECTED with the named `id_invalid` error — so it never installs and thus never has the mismatch. Actually the two options are mutually exclusive:
- Reject: padded manifest → named error, no install. Test: validation rejects with `id_invalid`.
- Rewrite: padded manifest installs with trimmed id AND normalized manifest bytes → badge renders, Remove works.

The reviewer's primary suggestion is the validator rule. But note: the previous round chose "trim" and the reviewer pointed out the remaining inconsistency. Now the cleanest fix per reviewer: reject in the validator with a named error.

But wait — there's a wrinkle: `WidgetPayloadValidator` is shared by catalog, publish, and local loads. If we add the "no leading/trailing whitespace" rule to the validator, it applies to all three consumers. Is that safe? Catalog widgets are curated; publish flows validate agent/user-created widgets before publishing — rejecting padded ids there is good (consistent with the id rule). `WidgetManifest.fromJson` trims, so a padded id in a catalog manifest would... `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses via WidgetManifest? Let me read apps_store.dart and widget_payload_validator.dart to understand.

Also the existing test suite: `test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — I'll need to add a test there for the new rule (RED first), and update loader/flow tests if their padded-id expectations change (the loader test from round 1 asserts padded id installs under trimmed id — that will now need to change to "padded id is rejected with id_invalid").

Hold on — the previous round's fix made `UnpackedInspection.id` trim and installed under the trimmed id. If the validator now rejects padded ids, the loader's trim becomes mostly moot (still harmless defense). The reviewer's concern: manifest bytes stored unchanged keep padded id → `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses padded id → mismatch. Two ways:
1. Reject padded ids in validator (no install at all) — the manifest never lands, so no mismatch ever. Loader test must change: padded id → validation error.
2. Rewrite manifest bytes at install with the trimmed id — badge works, remove works.

Option 1 is what the reviewer recommends ("rejecting is simpler and keeps the picked folder byte-honest"). And the re-review (Thread 14) Next Steps: "Reject ids where `id != id.trim()` in `WidgetPayloadValidator` (named `id_invalid` error) or write the normalized manifest — then pin with a badge-render + Remove-deletes-folder test".

Hmm, "then pin with a badge-render + Remove-deletes-folder test" — with option 1 (reject), what would that test look like? If we reject padded ids, then a valid trimmed-id manifest installs and badge/remove work — those already work today for trimmed ids presumably. The pin for THIS thread is: padded id never reaches an inconsistent state. With rejection, the test asserts:
- validator: padded id → `id_invalid` error (named).
- loader/flow: padded-id pick → issues dialog (or install refuses), nothing installed, `apps/` has no folder at all.

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`

`resizeToAvoidBottomInset` shrinks the body constraints around the
  keyboard, which DOES rebuild the LayoutBuilder.
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/chat_screen.dart` (ADAPTER over
  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

  `packages/fa_ui/lib/src/chat/fa_chat_screen.dart`; also re-exports
  `chatImageMessageSource`/`kWideLayoutBreakpoint`) — keeps the app's
  multi-session surface: the `FlutterSessionManager` subscription (session
  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which
  re-subscribes and re-syncs in place; closing the last session clones a
  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the
  package screen takes as hooks — the settings route (`settingsBuilder` →
  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →
  `FaChatHost.appLauncher` when set, else `pushJsApp`), and the composer
  test fakes (`composerBuilder` → the app's `ChatComposer` adapter).
  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/` — gen-l10n: `app_en.arb` + `app_ru.arb` →
  `AppLocalizations` (generated, never edit; `flutter gen-l10n`). UI copy
  via `context.l10n.<key>` (`l10n_ext.dart`); locale follows system.
  `test/l10n_guard_test.dart` hard-fails on hardcoded widget strings, en/ru
  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with
  `// l10n:ignore`, per file with `// l10n:ignore-file` (agent-facing/log
  strings stay literal).
- `flutter_app/test/golden/` — golden tests (see MANDATORY section below).
- `flutter_app/test/cli_visual/` — CLI visual integration tests
  (integration-tagged, excluded from the pre-commit `flutter test`): the
  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in
  `test/integration/pty_harness.dart` (see its README for the PTY/pty2
  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the
  output subscription in `close()`).
- `flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/model_presets.dart` — settings "Model presets"
  section: a swipeable `PageView` of `kModelPresets` cards applying a whole
  model combo in one tap (`applyModelPreset` — per-slot `MediaModelsStore`
  overrides, unmapped slots cleared, then `service.reconfigure` +
  `LastConnectionStore.saveFromConfig`; missing provider key = inline hint +
  jump to `ProviderEditorPage`, nothing applied). Add a preset by appending a
  `ModelPreset` to `kModelPresets` (doc comment there) plus its
  `modelPreset<Id>Name`/`...Description` arb keys; `ModelPresetTarget` is
  sealed for future custom/on-device targets. The presets headline the
  dedicated **Models** settings page
  (`flutter_app/lib/ui/screens/models_settings_page.dart` —
  `ModelsSettingsPage`: presets → `DefaultChatModelSection` →
  `TaskModelsSection` → `MediaModelsSection`), opened from the "Models"
  row on `SettingsScreen` (chip icon + chevron, ABOVE the Agents section)
  via `pushFaPage` — a centered dialog on wide canvases, full-screen on
  the phone — so the settings top level stays provider-focused; same
  layout on phone and macOS. The sections need the `MediaModelsScope`/`TaskModelsScope`
  from the app shell (tests: wrap ABOVE the MaterialApp — pushed routes
  build inside the Navigator, above `home:`).
- `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/sandbox_registry.dart` — central registry of
  sandbox shell commands per platform; the Fa system prompt's `{{commands}}`
  renders from it. Never list commands in prompt text or UI by hand.

  switch hands the shared screen the new active service, which

  fresh one via `ensureActiveSession`) plus the fa-specific affordances the

  `SettingsScreen`), the files panel (`fileBrowserBuilder` → `FileBrowser`
  with env/fsRevision), the `open_app` launcher (`service.appLauncher` →

  Composer changes must keep the chat goldens pixel-identical.

  key drift, placeholder mismatches, missing keys — opt out per line with

  real `dart bin/fah.dart` runs in a PTY (package:pty2) and every step is
  screenshotted through the real Flutter `TerminalView` (JetBrainsMono +
  Fa palette, `RepaintBoundary.toImage` at 2x) into the repo-root
  `test/integration/screenshots/NN_name.png` + a `.txt` twin with the exact
  xterm screen text. Run: `flutter test test/cli_visual --tags
  integration`. The pure-Dart counterpart harness lives in

  pitfalls: spawn `dart bin/fah.dart` NOT `dart run`, always cancel the

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist

+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {

+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '

+          ),
+        );
+      }

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

{"patch":"[flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart#12C1]
SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

{"patch":"[flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart#12C1]
SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

{"patch":"[flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart#12C1]
SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {

+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id

+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove

+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {

+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',

+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];

+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {

+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);

{"patch":"[flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart#12C1]
SWAP 341.=348:
+    // The id rule runs against the RAW manifest FIRST: a structurally
+    // broken manifest (a missing version, say) must still name its bad id
+    // in the same pass — the user fixes the folder in one round, not one
+    // error per retry.
+    final rawId = stamped['id'];
+    if (rawId is String && rawId.trim().isNotEmpty) {
+      // A padded id is refused, not silently trimmed: the picked folder
+      // is stored byte-honest, so an id trimmed only at the loader would
+      // come back padded out of the stored manifest
+      // (`JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw bytes) — the trimmed
+      // install record would miss it (no provenance badge) and Remove
+      // would target an `apps/<id> /` folder that does not exist
+      // (gh-1616 review, AC2: named errors, never silent weirdness).
+      if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
+        errors.add(
+          WidgetPayloadError(
+            'id_invalid',
+            "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
+                'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
+                'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
+          ),
+        );
+      }
+      _checkId(rawId.trim(), errors);
+    }"}

# Thread: padded manifest id — stored bytes keep the pad (badge lost, Remove no-ops)

Fixed with the reject option — the validator now refuses the padded id outright, so the "manifest id ≠ folder/record key" state is unreachable instead of merely papered over at the loader:

- `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart`) adds the one-rule check before the id-pattern rule:

  ```dart
  if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
    errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
      'id_invalid',
      "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
          'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
          'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
    ));
  }
  ```

  The named error carries both the raw and the trimmed form, so the user can fix `manifest.json` in one round. A padded id that ALSO breaks the id pattern names both problems (two `id_invalid` errors — the dedupe in `_checkId` keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message).
- The round-1 trim on `UnpackedInspection.id` stays as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states that the validator refuses the pad and why (stored manifest bytes are byte-honest — exactly the hazard this thread flagged: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` reads the raw `json['id']`, so a trim-only fix leaves the padded model id missing the trimmed `sources[...]` key and `removeWidget(app.id)` targeting a folder that does not exist).

Regression tests:

- `test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — "a whitespace-padded id is rejected with the trimmed form named" (exactly one `id_invalid`, message names whitespace + `fa-agents`) and "a padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems" (2 × `id_invalid`: whitespace + pattern).
- `test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart` — "a whitespace-padded manifest id is rejected before anything is written": `isValid == false`, named `id_invalid` with `whitespace` in the message, `install` throws `StateError`, and `apps/` is left completely empty (no trimmed folder, no padded sibling, no meta record).

## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart` — the padded-id rule (+17)
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart` — `UnpackedInspection.id` doc comment updated to the new contract
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb`, `app_ru.arb` (+ regenerated `app_localizations*.dart`) — `unpackedSourceUnknown`
- `flutter_app/test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — 2 new tests
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart` — round-1 trim-install test replaced by the reject contract + the badge/Remove pin (2 tests)
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — round-1 padded-id replace test replaced by the reject-dialog test + new unknown-origin test (2 tests)

## Test Coverage

TDD: the 5 new/updated tests were written first and failed on the pre-fix tree (`+40 -5`), then turned green.

- Validator: "a whitespace-padded id is rejected with the trimmed form named" (exactly one `id_invalid` naming whitespace + `fa-agents`); "a padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems".
- Loader: "a whitespace-padded manifest id is rejected before anything is written" (named error, `install` throws, `apps/` left empty); "a loaded widget keeps badge provenance and Remove deletes its folder" — the reviewer's pin: `installSource == 'unpacked'` renders and `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` deletes the code files AND the `.installed.json` record.
- Flow: "AC2: a padded-id pick is rejected by name, install untouched" (issues dialog, no replace confirm, existing install byte-identical); "an unknown future origin is surfaced, never read as catalog" (`origin: 'cli'` install → replace note reads "installed from an unknown source (cli)", no catalog phrase).

{"content":"# Thread: padded manifest id — stored bytes keep the pad (badge lost, Remove no-ops)

Fixed with the reject option — the validator now refuses the padded id outright, so the "manifest id ≠ folder/record key" state is unreachable instead of merely papered over at the loader:

- `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart`) adds the one-rule check before the id-pattern rule:

  ```dart
  if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
    errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
      'id_invalid',
      "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
          'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
          'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
    ));
  }
  ```

    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '

```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest.     "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest.     "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '

  ));

```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest.         'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. {"content":"# Thread: padded manifest id — stored bytes keep the pad (badge lost, Remove no-ops)

Fixed with the reject option — the validator now refuses the padded id outright, so the "manifest id ≠ folder/record key" state is unreachable instead of merely papered over at the loader:

- `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` (`flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart`) adds the one-rule check before the id-pattern rule:

  ```dart
  if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
    errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
      'id_invalid',
      "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
          'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
          'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
    ));
  }
  ```

  The named error carries both the raw and the trimmed form, so the user can fix `manifest.json` in one round. A padded id that ALSO breaks the id pattern names both problems (two `id_invalid` errors — the dedupe in `_checkId` keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message).
