{"content":"## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart` — the padded-id rule (+17)
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart` — `UnpackedInspection.id` doc comment updated to the new contract
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb`, `app_ru.arb` (+ regenerated `app_localizations*.dart`) — `unpackedSourceUnknown`
- `flutter_app/test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — 2 new tests
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart` — round-1 trim-install test replaced by the reject contract + the badge/Remove pin (2 tests)
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — round-1 padded-id replace test replaced by the reject-dialog test + new unknown-origin test (2 tests)

## Test Coverage

TDD: the 5 new/updated tests were written first and failed on the pre-fix tree (`+40 -5`), then turned green.

- Validator: "a whitespace-padded id is rejected with the trimmed form named" (exactly one `id_invalid` naming whitespace + `fa-agents`); "a padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems".
- Loader: "a whitespace-padded manifest id is rejected before anything is written" (named error, `install` throws, `apps/` left empty); "a loaded widget keeps badge provenance and Remove deletes its folder" — the reviewer's pin: `installSource == 'unpacked'` renders and `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` deletes the code files AND the `.installed.json` record.
- Flow: "AC2: a padded-id pick is rejected by name, install untouched" (issues dialog, no replace confirm, existing install byte-identical); "an unknown future origin is surfaced, never read as catalog" (`origin: 'cli'` install → replace note reads "installed from an unknown source (cli)", no catalog phrase).

The catalog/agent replace goldens are byte-identical (both known labels render exactly as before).

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff

  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"

  test-faui:

    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. ```

  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu

  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the

      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)

  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''

        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff

  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart` — the padded-id rule (+17)
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart` — `UnpackedInspection.id` doc comment updated to the new contract
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb`, `app_ru.arb` (+ regenerated `app_localizations*.dart`) — `unpackedSourceUnknown`
- `flutter_app/test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — 2 new tests
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart` — round-1 trim-install test replaced by the reject contract + the badge/Remove pin (2 tests)
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — round-1 padded-id replace test replaced by the reject-dialog test + new unknown-origin test (2 tests)

## Test Coverage

TDD: the 5 new/updated tests were written first and failed on the pre-fix tree (`+40 -5`), then turned green.

- Validator: "a whitespace-padded id is rejected with the trimmed form named" (exactly one `id_invalid` naming whitespace + `fa-agents`); "a padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems".
- Loader: "a whitespace-padded manifest id is rejected before anything is written" (named error, `install` throws, `apps/` left empty); "a loaded widget keeps badge provenance and Remove deletes its folder" — the reviewer's pin: `installSource == 'unpacked'` renders and `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` deletes the code files AND the `.installed.json` record.
- Flow: "AC2: a padded-id pick is rejected by name, install untouched" (issues dialog, no replace confirm, existing install byte-identical); "an unknown future origin is surfaced, never read as catalog" (`origin: 'cli'` install → replace note reads "installed from an unknown source (cli)", no catalog phrase).

Verification: targeted set (validator/loader/flow/goldens/l10n guard/launcher reality) **57 passed**; broader surface `flutter test test/apps test/golden test/l10n_guard_test.dart` all green; `flutter analyze` on all 7 touched files — no issues; `dart format` clean on the touched files. The catalog/agent replace goldens are byte-identical (both known labels render exactly as before).

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody

        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart` — the padded-id rule (+17)
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart` — `UnpackedInspection.id` doc comment updated to the new contract
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb`, `app_ru.arb` (+ regenerated `app_localizations*.dart`) — `unpackedSourceUnknown`
- `flutter_app/test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — 2 new tests
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_loader_test.dart` — round-1 trim-install test replaced by the reject contract + the badge/Remove pin (2 tests)
- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — round-1 padded-id replace test replaced by the reject-dialog test + new unknown-origin test (2 tests)

## Test Coverage

TDD: the 5 new/updated tests were written first and failed on the pre-fix tree (`+40 -5`), then turned green.

- Validator: "a whitespace-padded id is rejected with the trimmed form named" (exactly one `id_invalid` naming whitespace + `fa-agents`); "a padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems".
- Loader: "a whitespace-padded manifest id is rejected before anything is written" (named error, `install` throws, `apps/` left empty); "a loaded widget keeps badge provenance and Remove deletes its folder" — the reviewer's pin: `installSource == 'unpacked'` renders and `removeWidget(app.id, force: true)` deletes the code files AND the `.installed.json` record.
- Flow: "AC2: a padded-id pick is rejected by name, install untouched" (issues dialog, no replace confirm, existing install byte-identical); "an unknown future origin is surfaced, never read as catalog" (`origin: 'cli'` install → replace note reads "installed from an unknown source (cli)", no catalog phrase).

Verification: targeted set (validator/loader/flow/goldens/l10n guard/launcher reality) **57 passed**; broader surface `flutter test test/apps test/golden test/l10n_guard_test.dart` all green; `flutter analyze` on all 7 touched files — no issues; `dart format` clean on the touched files. The catalog/agent replace goldens are byte-identical (both known labels render exactly as before).

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

{"content":"## Issues/Notes

Rework of the two open review threads on the previous round (CI is green; no merge conflicts):

1. ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (`unpacked_loader.dart`)** — the round-1 trim normalized the folder/record but the **stored manifest bytes kept the padded id**: `JsAppInfo.fromManifest` parses the raw `json['id']`, so a `" fa-agents "` manifest produced a padded model id over trimmed records — provenance badge lost (`sources[app.id]` misses) and Remove silently no-ops (`removeWidget(app.id)` targets `apps/ fa-agents /`, still returns `true`).
2. 💡 **SUGGESTION (`unpacked_load_flow.dart`)** — the source-label switch's `_` default labels any unknown origin as "installed from the catalog" (and, in fact, today's literal `catalog` value was the `_` arm's payload — the honest future-origin label was unreachable for any new value).

The 7 remaining open threads are machine records (review-verdict / rework-consume audit boilerplate, "Please do not edit or reply") with no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` to target — no reply is possible or expected for them.

## Approach

**Thread 1 — reject, don't trim (the reviewer's simpler, byte-honest option).** `WidgetPayloadValidator._checkSchema` now emits a named `id_invalid` error when `rawId.trim() != rawId`, before the existing id-pattern rule (which still runs on the trimmed form):

```dart
if (rawId.trim() != rawId) {
  errors.add(WidgetPayloadError(
    'id_invalid',
    "manifest id '$rawId' carries leading/trailing whitespace — "
        'the id rule runs on the trimmed form (${rawId.trim()}); '
        'write it unpadded in manifest.json',
  ));
}
```

A padded id can therefore never reach `installWidget` — the mismatch class (badge lost / Remove no-op) is unreachable by construction, and the picked folder stays byte-honest. A padded id that ALSO breaks the pattern names both problems (the `_checkId` dedupe keys on quoted ids and is not fooled by the new message). `UnpackedInspection.id` keeps its trim as last-resort normalization for reporting; its doc comment now states the validator refusal and why.

**Thread 2 — honest labels.** The switch gained an explicit `'catalog'` case plus a catch-all that surfaces the raw value via a new neutral arb key instead of claiming catalog provenance:

```dart
final sourceLabel = source == null
    ? ''
    : switch (source) {
        'catalog' => l10n.unpackedSourceCatalog,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.origin => l10n.unpackedSourceUnpacked,
        UnpackedWidgetLoader.agentCreatedSource => l10n.unpackedSourceAgent,
        final unknown => l10n.unpackedSourceUnknown(unknown),
      };
```

`unpackedSourceUnknown` — en "installed from an unknown source ({source})", ru "установлен из неизвестного источника ({source})" — `flutter gen-l10n` regenerated; en/ru added symmetrically (l10n guard green).

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/widget_payload_validator.dart` — the padded-id rule (+17)
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_loader.dart` — `UnpackedInspection.id` doc comment updated to the new contract
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/unpacked_load_flow.dart` — source-label switch: explicit `catalog` case + verbatim unknown-source default; `existingSource` doc updated
- `flutter_app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb`, `app_ru.arb` (+ regenerated `app_localizations*.dart`) — `unpackedSourceUnknown`
- `flutter_app/test/apps/widget_payload_validator_test.dart` — 2 new tests

- `flutter_app/test/apps/unpacked_load_flow_test.dart` — round-1 padded-id replace test replaced by the reject-dialog test + new unknown-origin test (2 tests)

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N1 — the macOS exclusion-zone leg. By #177 design the ubuntu
  # PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (issue #1267 N1 slice 2): ci.yml has NO pull_request
  # trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM workflow_dispatch on the head
  # SHA (machine-sm.yml). The changes classifier derives the validated diff
  # under BOTH events (merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) on dispatches), so
  # this leg is PATH-TRIGGERED: a PR touching only lib/src core never pays
  # for it (AC1), a lib/apps + js_ext diff does, and a classifier failure
  # fails safe (the leg runs). Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it —
  # gh-1538 retired the nightly flutter-app-macos full-suite backstop
  # (nightly is builds + integration-only now), so this pre-merge leg is
  # the macOS coverage for the JS-engine surface.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') &&
      needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true' &&
      needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Pinned stable channel, same as the retired nightly
      # flutter-app-macos leg used (gh-1538).
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Issue #1267 N2 (AC2) — lockfile-modified release smoke. Resolution
  # floats transitive deps to latest-compatible on every resolve, and the
  # breaking arrival (#1265: a transitive flutter_inappwebview nobody
  # declares) lands as a flutter_app/pubspec.lock diff — a surface the PR
  # legs never built: the native linux/windows desktop targets were
  # nightly-only (nightly.yml build-release), so the break surfaced as the
  # 5-red-nights window instead of a red PR. When the diff MODIFIES the
  # lockfile, this matrix release-builds the app on linux+windows pre-merge
  # (the same two targets the nightly carries); every other PR pays
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: crap_report
          path: flutter_app/crap_report.json
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Pixel and flutter gates over test/golden/goldens (issue 447)
        if: needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true'
        run: cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart check

  # Issue #283: fa_ui tests sharded ×3 by the test-core template — a
  # duration-balanced manifest (scripts/faui_test_shards.json, rebalanced
  # weekly by shard-rebalance.yml), one file executed by exactly ONE shard,
  # goldens excluded exactly as before (host-locked). Shards fan out INSIDE
  # the job graph; only the aggregate Quality gate is a required check, so
  # a red shard = red gate and path-skipped = neutral (AC4 semantics). A
  # single failed matrix leg can be rerun alone via "Re-run failed jobs"
  # (E1) — the gate then re-aggregates the same results.
  test-faui:
    name: fa_ui tests (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.app == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 12
    permissions:
      contents: read
